runs.text: The Bible clearly tells us that God created the world in six literal days and rested on the seventh day. Many reject this narrative and believe instead that our complex world has evolved over billions of years.

There is another erroneous belief within Christianity that believes God was indeed the creator of the world, but that He created it over thousands of years using an evolutionary process. In this study we will learn that each day of creation consisted of an evening and morning, and that God did indeed create a perfect world in six literal 24-hour days.
JESUS TAUGHT THAT WE WERE CREATED:
1. Who did Jesus say created us at the beginning?
Mark 10:6
But from the beginning of the creation God made them
male and female.”
Note:
This is Jesus speaking. He treated Genesis as history. He placed the creation of Adam and Eve at the very beginning—at creation itself—not billions of years after some evolutionary process.
ARCHAEOLOGY - WALLS OF JERICHO:
2. What happened to the walls of Jericho?
Hebrews 11:30
By faith the walls of Jericho fell down
, after they were compassed about seven days.”
Note:
There are multiple archaeological discoveries that prove the Bible. The top discoveries are the
Pilate Stone
Moabite Stone
Sennacherib’s Prism
The Dead Sea Scrolls,
and the
Walls of Jericho

Excavations show Jericho had been destroyed several times. But, one level revealed that the walls had "fallen flat outward.” (See Joshua 6:5) Further checking revealed that this particular level had a layer of ash which was far too thick. The city had been burned, but the loot (the furnishings and grain storage) had not been taken! (See Joshua 6:18) The fallen walls and thick ash, had occurred approximately at the time when Joshua and his army invaded the land about 1400 B.C.
Palestine Exploration Quarterly 1930s issues.
GOD IS THE CREATOR:
3. Who created the heavens and earth?
Genesis 1:1
“In the beginning
God created the heaven and the earth
Note:
The very first thing the Bible tells us in the book of Genesis is that God the Father, the one true God was the creator. This is the consistent testimony of Scripture from beginning to end.
4. Whom did Jesus say was the creator?
Matthew 19:4
And he (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female
Note:
Jesus is quoting Genesis 1:1. He consistently pointed to the Father as the Creator and the one He prayed to and obeyed. (See Matthew 26:39, John 14:31)
5. Whom did the Apostle Paul say was the creator?
1 Corinthians 8:6
“Yet for us
there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things and for whom we exist, and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things and through whom we exist.
Note:
The Apostle Paul tells us that all things are from God the Father. (See also Acts 17:24)
GOD CREATED, THROUGH JESUS:
6. Whom did God use to create all things?
John 1:1
In the beginning was the Word
, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. 2
The same was in the beginning with God.
All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.”
Note:
John 1:14 tells us that the Word is Jesus. These verses are referring to Jesus as the
agent
or instrument through whom the Father worked (like a master worker or the one for whom creation was purposed).
7. By whom did God create all things?
Colossians 1:13
“(God)
Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness,
and hath
translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
14 In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins: 15
Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
Note:
These verses explain that God the Father, who delivered us from the power of darkness, has a dear Son, and “
by Him, were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible
Hebrews 1:1-2
God) “Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son
, whom he hath appointed heir of all things,
by whom also he made the worlds
GOD CREATES BY SPEAKING:
8. How did God create light?
Genesis 1:3
“And God said,
Let there be light: and there was light
(Repeated throughout the chapter.)
Note:
The repeated phrase “And God said… and it was so…” shows instantaneous creation by divine command, not slow evolutionary processes over eons.
9. How does God create?
Psalm 33:9
For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast
Note:
God cannot lie. (Hebrews 6:18) The reason God cannot lie is because when He speaks, He creates. If God were to tell a lie, He would create the very thing He spoke. (See also Hebrews 11:3)
SIX DAYS OF CREATION:
10. How long did it take God to create the earth?
Exodus 20:11
For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
Note:
God created the earth in six literal days, and rested on the seventh day.
11. How many evenings and mornings in each day?
Genesis 1:5
And the evening and the morning were the first day
(This phrase is repeated for each day.)
Note:

The phrase “evening and morning” is used over 30 times in the Old Testament and always refers to a normal 24-hour day. There is no contextual or grammatical reason in Genesis 1 to treat these as long geological ages instead of ordinary days.
12. How long did each Sabbath last?
Leviticus 23:32
From evening to evening you shall celebrate your sabbath
NKJV
Note:

The Sabbath has been consecutively kept on the seventh day of each week beginning from the original day where God rested on creation week. What this does is it establishes the length of each day of creation.
13. For how long was Israel to keep the Sabbath?
Exodus 31:16
“Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath,
to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever
: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
Note:
The weekly Sabbath is given as a perpetual sign based on God’s literal six days of work and the seventh day of rest. A non-literal creation week breaks this direct connection.
A YOUNG EARTH:
14. Did God create plants before the sun?
Genesis 1:11-13
(Day 3)
Genesis 1:14-19
(Day 4).
Note:

Plants were created on the third day, before the sun on the fourth day. This order makes perfect sense with a literal reading but creates major problems for any evolutionary timeline that requires the sun first for photosynthesis over thousands, or millions of years.
15. Were sea creatures and birds created before land animals?
Genesis 1:20-23
(Day 5)
Genesis 1:24-25
(Day 6).
Note:
Birds and sea creatures appear on Day 5, land animals on Day 6. This order directly contradicts the standard evolutionary sequence of birds appearing last.
16. Does the genealogical record in Genesis support a young earth?
Genesis 5 and Genesis 11
(Genealogies from Adam to Abraham).
Note:
These detailed father-to-son genealogies, when added up, place creation only thousands of years ago, not billions.
THEISTIC EVOLUTION:
17. Is there any biblical precedent for a “day” meaning thousands of years?
2 Peter 3:8
“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that
one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day
Note:
Theistic evolution is the belief that God created the world, but that he created using the evolution process.

This verse is about God’s perspective on time and patience, not a redefinition of the creation days. Using this verse to prove theistic evolution ignores the context and the specific qualifiers (evening and morning), in Genesis 1.
18. Did God rest on the seventh day as a pattern for us?
Genesis 2:2
And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it
Note:
God’s rest on the seventh day becomes the model for the human work week. If the seventh day is still ongoing (as some claim), the pattern for weekly rest collapses.
19. Was the creation “finished” after six days?
Genesis 2:1
Thus the heavens and the earth were finished
, and all the host of them. 2 And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made.”
Note:
The work of creation was declared “finished.” Theistic evolution requires ongoing creative processes over thousands of years.
20. Can theistic evolution be reconciled with “no death before sin”?
Romans 8:20-22
“For the creature was made subject to vanity… because of him who hath subjected the same in hope…
the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now
Note:
The curse affected the entire creation after Adam’s sin. Thousands of years of death and suffering before sin make the curse and the need for redemption meaningless.
21. Does the Bible ever describe creation as a slow process?
Psalm 33:6, 9
“By the word of the LORD were the heavens made…
For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast
Note:
Creation was by instantaneous divine command, not gradual development.
SCIENCE VS. CREATION:
Disclaimer:

Some of the following ideas are strongly debated by scientists who believe in evolution. We humbly present them as real observations from the world around us. Creation scientists see these findings as supporting the Bible’s account of a young earth and a worldwide flood in Noah’s day.)
22. What if we try to fit evolution into Genesis?
Colossians 2:8
Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men... and not after Christ.
Note:

Scientists have found soft, stretchy blood vessels, proteins like collagen, and other delicate tissues inside dinosaur bones said to be 65 million years old or older. These soft materials normally break down in just thousands of years. In 2025 researchers shared more discoveries, including preserved skin with visible cells and possible hemoglobin traces. (
Scientific Reports, Feb 4, 2025
Creation scientist Dr. Brian Thomas says: “The fact that we have soft dinosaur tissue in these fossils shows they can’t even be a million years old.”
23. Who was really there at the beginning?
Job 38:4
Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth
? declare, if thou hast understanding.”
Note:
God was there. He wrote the account in Genesis. We can trust the eyewitness testimony of the Creator more than the changing ideas of men who were not there.
24. What about helium trapped in tiny crystals?
Psalm 102:25
In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
NIV
Note:

God’s fingerprints are all over the foundation of the earth. Tiny crystals called zircons are found inside granite rock. As uranium inside them decays, it produces helium gas. Helium escapes from crystals fairly quickly. Yet measurements show these zircons (thought by some to be over a billion years old) still contain a lot of helium. Creation scientists say this points to an age of only thousands of years.
25. Can we trust God’s Word over changing scientific ideas?
Psalm 119:89
Forever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven
Note:

These things, soft tissue in dinosaur bones and helium still trapped in zircon crystals are real observations. Many see them as signs that the earth is young and was shaped by rapid events just as the Bible describes. (
Humphreys, D.R., et al. 2003/2004
26. What about carbon-14 found in “ancient” things?
Hebrews 1:10
“In the beginning, Lord,
you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands
NIV
Note:

Carbon-14 breaks down in tens of thousands of years. Yet measurable amounts have been found in dinosaur bones, coal, and diamonds said to be millions of years old. Tests on dinosaur fossils give radiocarbon results in the tens of thousands of years. Creation scientists see this as strong evidence the fossils are much younger than claimed.
SOFT TISSUE DISCOVERIES:

Recent reports show more than 58 discoveries of soft tissue, proteins, skin cells, and delicate remains in dinosaur fossils from around the world. Some specimens even showed slightly pliable blood vessels and visible individual cells. (
Schweitzer, M.H., et al. 2007
A 2026 article from
Creation Ministries International
states: “Dinosaur soft tissue, proteins, and DNA could not last millions of years. Everything we know from science tells us that these things cannot possibly be millions of years old.”
27. What do these observations tell us about the age of the earth’s foundations?
Psalm 104:5
He set the earth on its foundations
it can never be moved
Note:

The helium in zircons, the carbon-14 in dinosaur bones, and the soft tissues all point in the same direction. They suggest the earth and the fossils are much younger than usually taught. Creation scientists continue to study these things and believe they line up with the Bible’s timeline of thousands of years, not billions.
Thomas, B. and Nelson, V. 2015
FEAR NOT LITTLE FLOCK, GOD IS IN CONTROL:
(See Luke 12:32)
28. What does all this mean for our daily lives?
Romans 1:20
For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead
Note:

Knowing God created everything quickly and perfectly helps us remember He is in control. When we see the beauty of the world or read about these scientific finds, we can praise Him. It also reminds us why we need a Savior — because sin brought death and suffering into a once-perfect creation.

Every year more reports come in of delicate tissues preserved in dinosaur bones. Creation scientists involved in these studies say the evidence keeps pointing back to rapid burial during the Flood, not slow processes over millions of years.
29. How does the Sabbath connect to all of this?
Genesis 2:2

By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work. Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done
Note:

God rested on the seventh day and made it holy. He later commanded Israel to keep the Sabbath as a sign that He made the world in six days and rested on the seventh. The Sabbath reminds us every week that our Creator finished His work and we can trust Him.
30. How should we respond when scientists disagree?
Isaiah 40:8
The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God endures forever
Note:
We do not have to fear the changing ideas of men. God’s Word stands forever. These observations encourage us to read Genesis with fresh eyes and share the truth about our Creator with others.
31. Are the rocks crying out to you? Is God summoning the foundations of the earth?
Isaiah 48:13
My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they all stand up together
Note:

The rocks cannot literally speak and tell us what happened at the beginning. But God is summoning them to stand up and testify! It was God’s own hand that laid the foundation the earth. These scientific observations are standing up today telling us that God’s creation declares His glory (Psalm 19:1). They encourage us to trust His unchanging Word more than human ideas that keep changing.
CONCLUSION:

The Bible clearly teaches that God created a perfect world in six literal 24-hour days. Jesus Himself tells us that God was the creator. The Sabbath command is built directly on this literal six-day week.

While some scientists explain the evidence differently, we choose to stand firmly on God’s unchanging Word. The weekly Sabbath remains a beautiful, ongoing sign reminding us of our Creator and His finished work.
God has a deep love for man. God did not speak man into existence like the rest of creation.
“The Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.”
(See Genesis 2:7.) When man sinned, God responded with His love. In His love for mankind God emptied his treasuries of His most prized possession. God gave us His Son.

Let us worship our loving Father who sent His Son, Jesus Christ, to save us from sin and to give us eternal life. May these truths strengthen your faith, encourage your walk with the Lord, and help you share the good news of our Creator and Redeemer.
